documents.t: sdv-py KHL: endpoint references, dataset loaders and parsers for KHL in the SportsDataverse Python package.

Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.hockey.khl — 14 endpoints. Note: Owner flag (sdv-internal-refs/khl/README.md): the KHL and its webcaster platform are run by Russian operators, some clubs by sanctioned state companies. Fetching on your own machine is fine; any published data release, hosted mirror or redistribution needs owner (sanctions / legal) sign-off first.

Season schedule and results of a tournament, one row per game (All-Star games dropped). Endpoint URL: POST https://www.khl.ru/rest/calendar/list/ Valid URL: https://www.khl.ru/rest/calendar/list/?season=2026&stage=regular

return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw khl.ru envelope Dict ({status, data, errors}).
